Class CodecRedisCacheProperties

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.codec.autoconfigure.CodecRedisCacheProperties
@ConfigurationProperties(prefix="codec.redis.cache") public class CodecRedisCacheProperties extends Object
Settings for serializing Redis cache values through the application's CodecFactory.

Cache values are heterogeneous but a codec is typed, so each cache that should go through codec names its value type; unlisted caches keep Spring Boot's default serializer. A backend whose format is self-describing (Apache Fory) can serve every cache from one codec for Object — set default-type to java.lang.Object for that.
